## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `microsoft-onedrive-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Register the application

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [Microsoft Entra admin center](https://entra.microsoft.com/). -->
2. Navigate to **App registrations** and select **New registration**.
3. <!-- manual: Enter a display name for your application. -->
4. <!-- manual: Under Supported account types, select the appropriate option for your use case. -->
5. <!-- manual: Leave Redirect URI blank for now. -->
6. Select **Register**.
7. After registration, copy the **Application (client) ID** from the Overview pane.

## Step 3: Configure platform settings

1. Under **Manage**, select **Authentication**.
2. Under **Platform configurations**, select **Add a platform**.
3. Select **Web** tile.
4. Set the **Redirect URI** to `http://localhost`.
5. Select **Configure** to save.

## Step 4: Add a client secret

1. Navigate to **Certificates & secrets > Client secrets** and select **New client secret**.
2. <!-- manual: Add a description for your client secret. -->
3. Select an expiration period and select **Add**.
4. Copy and save the **Value** of the secret immediately — it will not be shown again.
